label: PF Backlog 560
title: In-session manual/auto worker mode + /wg watch monitoring + 14-guidelines approval gates
body:
## Why
The worker currently runs only as a headless background daemon where the user cannot see proposals,
guide decisions, or approve steps. Users need to run the worker interactively in their active CLI session
under the 14 binding guidelines with mandatory approval gates, while retaining headless mode (auto)
and live progress monitoring (/wg watch).

## What
- In-session manual worker mode (/wg work manual, default):
  1. Claims assignment atomically from PF via /assignments/claim (PF creates isolated worktree off develop).
  2. Follows the 14 guidelines (RECONCILIATION block, IMPACT REVIEW table, plain language summary, risks).
  3. Pauses for operator approval BEFORE coding; on approval, implements & tests in worktree.
  4. Pauses for operator approval BEFORE delivery; on approval, completes via /assignments/{id}/complete (PF delivery merges to develop).
- Headless auto mode (/wg work auto): runs autonomous wg-agent with self-approval.
- /wg watch [--epic ID] [--follow]: live console monitoring of active assignments & journal events.
- Zero references to specific AI tool frameworks or legacy dashboards in core PF modules (framework-agnostic).

## Where
- workergrid/wg.py: cmd_watch, cmd_work subcommands (claim, complete, release, fail, heartbeat)
- workergrid/client.py: claim_assignment, complete_assignment, release_assignment, fail_assignment helpers
- product-forge/.opencode/command_global/wg.md & command/wg.md: 14-guidelines interactive session protocol
- test-framework/tests/pipeline/test_workergrid_session_worker.py: end-to-end tests

## Verify
- Python compileall, unit tests, wg_surface_check, lint check.
- End-to-end manual claim, lifecycle, and watch verification.
